# New Media Tek

> Enterprise .NET Development, AI-Accelerated.
> Led by a Senior .NET Architect with 15+ years of Fortune 500 experience.

## Company Overview
New Media Tek is a B2B software development agency specializing in high-performance .NET solutions. We combine deep enterprise architecture expertise with AI-augmented development processes to deliver software faster without compromising quality or security. Our unique "Senior-Led" model ensures every project is architected by experienced professionals.

## Core Services

### 1. Custom .NET Applications
- **Description:** Enterprise-grade ASP.NET Core and MVC solutions built with N-tier architecture.
- **Key Tech:** .NET 10, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core 10, SQL Server, C# 14.
- **Use Cases:** High-frequency trading platforms, internal enterprise tools, complex data processing systems.
- **AI Integration:** AI-assisted code generation, automated unit testing, intelligent refactoring.

### 2. REST APIs & Microservices
- **Description:** Scalable, secure API architectures designed for high availability.
- **Key Tech:** WCF (Legacy support), RESTful APIs, Redis Caching, SignalR, gRPC.
- **Performance:** Optimized for sub-second response times and high concurrency.
- **AI Features:** Automated API documentation generation, intelligent endpoint testing.

### 3. Legacy Modernization
- **Description:** Expert migration of legacy systems to modern cloud-native architectures.
- **Capabilities:**
  - .NET Framework (2.0-4.8) -> .NET 10
  - Monolith -> Microservices
  - Web Forms -> React 19/Angular 21/Blazor
  - On-premise -> Azure Cloud/AWS
- **AI Tools:** Automated code analysis, migration pattern recognition, risk assessment.

### 4. Enterprise Architecture
- **Description:** Strategic technical planning for large-scale systems.
- **Focus:** Scalability, Security, Compliance (HIPAA, SOC2 standards awareness), Cloud Integration.
- **Deliverables:** Architecture diagrams, scalability plans, security frameworks, migration roadmaps.

### 5. UX/UI Design & Frontend
- **Description:** Modern, responsive interfaces bridging complex enterprise logic with intuitive user experiences.
- **Key Tech:** React 19, Angular 21, Blazor, TypeScript, Figma, Enterprise Design Systems.
- **Capabilities:** Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), Responsive Dashboards, SPA Development, Component Libraries.
- **AI Enhancement:** AI-powered design system generation, automated accessibility testing.

### 6. Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
- **Description:** Secure, scalable cloud architecture and automated deployment pipelines.
- **Key Tech:** Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform (IaC), GitHub Actions.
- **Focus:** 99.99% Availability, Security Compliance, Auto-scaling, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code.
- **AI Operations:** Predictive scaling, automated monitoring, intelligent alerting.

### 7. Cloud Data Migration
- **Description:** Seamless migration of on-premises databases and data warehouses to cloud platforms.
- **Key Tech:** AWS Database Migration Service (DMS), Azure Data Migration Service, Data Lake migration.
- **Capabilities:** Zero-downtime transitions, comprehensive data integrity validation, schema mapping.

### 8. Cloud Platform Integrations
- **Description:** Deep expertise in AWS and Azure cloud services integration.
- **Key Tech:** AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, EKS), Azure (App Service, Azure SQL, Functions, AKS).
- **Focus:** Serverless Architecture, Multi-Cloud Strategy, Cloud-native applications.

### 9. ML.NET & Machine Learning
- **Description:** Native .NET machine learning with Python integration for data science workflows.
- **Key Tech:** ML.NET 5.0, Python, TorchSharp, PyTorch, Natural Language Processing.
- **Capabilities:** Predictive models, deep learning integration, NLP, intelligent .NET applications.

### 10. Power BI Analytics
- **Description:** Embedded Power BI dashboards and analytics within .NET applications.
- **Key Tech:** Power BI Embedded, Interactive Dashboards, Real-time Data Visualization.
- **Use Cases:** Business intelligence, executive reporting, enterprise decision-making.

### 11. Advanced Data Architecture
- **Description:** Scalable data architectures with .NET and Python data pipelines.
- **Key Tech:** EF Core 10, Python ETL, Data Governance, Performance Optimization.
- **Capabilities:** Enterprise-scale analytics, automated data transformation, data quality assurance.

## Technical Expertise
- **Backend:** .NET 10, C# 14, ASP.NET Core, Web API, WCF, gRPC.
- **Data:** SQL Server, Entity Framework Core 10, Redis, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Power BI.
- **Machine Learning:** ML.NET 5.0, Python, TorchSharp, PyTorch, NLP.
- **Frontend:** React 19, Angular 21, TypeScript, Blazor, HTML5, CSS3.
- **Cloud & DevOps:** Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions.
- **AI Integration:** GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT API, Claude AI, custom AI tooling.
- **Testing:** Automated unit testing, integration testing, performance testing.

## The Senior-Led Advantage
Unlike agencies that rely heavily on junior developers, New Media Tek is "Senior-Led."
- **Leadership:** Projects are architected and overseen by a Senior .NET Architect with Fortune 500 background.
- **Team Structure:** Lean, expert team (Senior Architect, Mid-Level Dev, UX/UI Designer, DevOps Engineer).
- **Outcome:** Enterprise-grade code quality, reduced technical debt, and faster time-to-market.
- **AI Augmentation:** 40% faster delivery through intelligent automation while maintaining human oversight.

## Industry Experience
- **Finance:** Trading platforms, risk management systems, compliance software.
- **Healthcare:** HIPAA-compliant applications, medical records systems, telehealth platforms.
- **Manufacturing:** ERP systems, inventory management, IoT integration.
- **Retail:** E-commerce platforms, customer analytics, supply chain systems.

## Development Methodology
1. **AI-Assisted Discovery:** Automated requirements analysis and architecture planning
2. **Senior Architecture Review:** Every design reviewed by Senior .NET Architect
3. **AI-Augmented Development:** Code generation, automated testing, continuous integration
4. **Quality Assurance:** Human oversight with AI-powered testing and analysis
5. **Deployment & Monitoring:** Automated CI/CD with intelligent monitoring
